name: browser-frame
title: Browser frame
description: A browser window drawn in CSS around a screenshot or live UI: tab, address bar and window controls, in calm monochrome.
docs: Wrap anything in it: a screenshot (an img is made block and full width) or live UI. url is written in the address bar, plain by default or a real link that opens in a new tab with href (the link is the one part of the chrome that stays in the accessibility tree, and says it opens a new tab). title adds a tab; without it the dots and the address share one row, and the address is centred in a field of its own that stands out from the strip in every tone. The chrome is lines and radii only, with three neutral window dots: no images, and no copy of a real browser. It follows the theme tokens, or fix it with tone='light' or tone='dark', for a dark window around a light screenshot whatever the page's theme. The chrome is hidden from assistive technology, and the figure has one caption that says what the window shows: your caption, or a hidden one such as 'Browser window showing Overview, app.northwind.example/overview'. It narrows to 320px without clipping: the address and the tab truncate first. It is a server component, so no script is shipped.
